### Problem
What research or engineering gap does this address?

### Proposed approach
Describe a minimal deliverable and any trade-offs.

### How will we verify it?
List measurable success criteria (e.g., model contract test, measured SRAM, repeatable accuracy check).

### Scope
Is this for PC reference code, data, documentation, tooling or real STM32 hardware?

### Dependencies and licensing
Any additional tools, datasets, third-party artifacts or permissions required?
